A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same UniLS study. All 13 pages of each version, including the supplementary material, are readable; text, equations, tables and figures support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark results, ablations, a 25-participant user study, runtime measurements and supplementary evaluation of the audio-free generator.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including Tables 1-5 and the qualitative comparisons.

M1.justification: Sections 4.2-4.4 retain the multi-scale codec, audio-free autoregressive training, dual-audio cross-attention and LoRA fine-tuning. Changing 'autoregressive free generator' to 'audio-free generator' does not alter the method.

E1.justification: Both versions use Seamless Interaction, CelebV, TalkingHead-1KH, TEDTalk and VFHQ for the same speaking/listening tasks. The corrected data-hour total does not introduce or remove dataset, domain or scenario coverage.

E2.justification: Tables 1-2 retain DiffPoseTalk, ARTalk, ARTalk* and DualTalk with the same applicable comparisons. The qualitative and runtime comparisons also retain their comparator membership; citation renumbering does not change the baselines.

E3.justification: Section 5.1 changes the filtered conversational-data total from 675.5 to 657.5 hours. This matches both unchanged breakdowns: 251.5 speaking plus 406.0 listening hours, and 622.5/4.8/30.2 training/validation/test hours. The evidence supports a reporting correction, without establishing changed data processing or rerun experiments.

E4.justification: Section 5.5/Table 3 retains the single-cross-attention, no-stage-1 and no-multi-scenario-data ablations. The audio-motion analysis in Figure 2 and supplementary stage-1-only evaluation in Section 7/Table 5 are also unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions report the same point estimates and user-preference percentages. Neither supplies training-run or seed counts, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests; the statistical reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: All result entries in Tables 1-5 are unchanged, including UniLS speaking LVE 5.83, listening F-FID 4.304 and throughput 560.6 FPS. The empirical plots and qualitative examples also remain the same. The data-volume correction is a setting-description change, not a performance result.

T1.justification: The motion representation, codec equations, autoregressive conditioning and reconstruction objective in Section 4 and Equations 1-4 are unchanged. No mathematical assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or removed.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain the same claims about audio-only unified speaking/listening, two-stage training, state-of-the-art speaking accuracy, up to 44.1% listening improvement and real-time applicability.

C2.justification: The explanations involving weak audio-listening correlation and internal motion priors are retained. Section 6 preserves the limitations concerning semantic understanding and chunk-boundary discontinuities; supplementary interpretations and ethical qualifications are unchanged.

D1.justification: The codec configuration, chunk length, optimizer, learning rate, batch sizes, iteration counts, frozen audio encoder, hardware and training-time disclosures are unchanged. Supplementary user-study procedures and resource-access information are also retained without additions.

R1.justification: Four cited works are removed: v1 references [16] and [18]-[20], concerning gaze prediction, action segmentation, EgoExoLearn and Vinci. The remaining works are retained, with some citation placement changes; the main related-work discussion and positioning against DualTalk remain unchanged.

P1.justification: Small wording edits standardize 'audio-free generator', remove 'expressive' from one introductory sentence and correct 'method A and B' to 'methods A and B' in Figure 6's caption. Section order and nearly all explanatory prose remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 3 adds explicit 'Output:' labels and adjusts motion-index spacing. Figure 5 is displayed slightly smaller, and text and references reflow. The figure/table inventory, table structures and underlying empirical visuals are retained.

improvement.justification: v2 corrects the conversational-data total from 675.5 to 657.5 hours, resolving its inconsistency with both retained breakdowns in Section 5.1. More consistent generator terminology and explicit Figure 3 output labels slightly improve clarity. These are limited accuracy and presentation gains; the scientific evidence and stated limitations remain unchanged.
